discovery.point: After the first Conan pair completed and while the first PyRollbar treatment episode was running.
discovery.confound: Minimal B explicitly told the Agent that clean replay starts at the repository root and may use an absolute path different from /data/project. Incremental V4 returned from prompt construction before receiving that path-portability contract.
discovery.observed_consequence: Both V4 trajectories persisted /data/project commands. Fresh replay placed the repository below /data/project, so project installation targeted the wrong directory. Conan eventually repaired the path after three plan revisions; PyRollbar repeatedly misattributed the resulting internal missing imports to network or dependency strategy.
discovery.scope: The study compared both deployment methods and unequal replay-path information, so it cannot estimate the causal effect of transactional editable programs.

pyrollbar_v4.state: interrupted after the confound was established

claim_boundary: Do not report a Hard6 success-rate or efficiency effect from this terminated study.
Retain the trajectories as mechanism evidence for replay-path drift, repair behavior, network-noise attribution, and deployment-quality annotation.
The Conan pair may illustrate behavior but is not a causal comparison because prompt information differed.

resolution.change: Give every incremental runner the same path-independent fresh-replay contract already supplied to whole-program methods.
resolution.rerun_policy: Use the same prospectively fixed Hard6 identities and paired controls; do not replace cases based on pilot outcomes.
